answer: Require every new account to enter on a public vouch thread: an established sponsor locks a refundable bond behind it, forfeited if the newcomer is proven a Sybil. This prices each fake identity at a separate stake, and falcon-style graph scans catch the attacker anyway: Sybil islands form voucher clusters whose accounts all misbehave together, so the scan slashes the entire chain instead of one fake at a time.
